text.id: Sri Rejeki masuk dermaga jam satu kurang dua puluh. Mesinnya batuk dua kali sebelum mati. Orang-orang BPM udah pergi.
text.en: The Sri Rejeki comes in at twenty to one. Its engine coughs twice before it dies. The BPM men are gone.

text.id: Yanti nelpon saya. Kamu ke rumah abang saya.
text.en: Yanti called me. You went to my brother's house.

text.id: Pak Karta yang nunjukin bukunya.
text.en: Pak Karta showed me the book himself.

text.id: Abang saya sakit. Dia nggak ngerti apa yang dia tunjukin.
text.en: My brother is sick. He doesn't understand what he's showing.

text.id: "Terus kamu mau apa?" Tunjukkan kalau lo udah tahu ke mana dia.
text.en: "So what do you want?" Show him you already know where she went.

text.id: Itu nggak ngejawab apa-apa.
text.en: That doesn't answer anything.

text.id: Saya nggak punya urusan sama kamu. Pulang.
text.en: I've got no business with you. Go home.

text.id: Dia naik lagi ke kapalnya dan mulai ngegulung tali, punggungnya ke gue. Gue nunggu sepuluh menit. Punggungnya nggak pernah balik.
text.en: He climbs back onto his boat and starts coiling rope, his back to me. I wait ten minutes. His back never turns.

text.id: Pak Hendra ngelihat layar HP gue lama. Terus dia duduk di ember terbaliknya, kayak orang yang akhirnya naruh barang berat.
text.en: Pak Hendra looks at my screen for a long time. Then he sits on his upturned bucket, like a man finally setting down something heavy.

text.id: Senin malem dia dateng jam sepuluh kurang. Bawa tas sama alat rekamnya. Ada satu orang lagi yang udah nunggu di kapal. Orang kantor.
text.en: Monday night she came at a little before ten. With her bag and her recording gear. There was someone else already waiting on the boat. An office man.

text.id: Pak Darmawan. Orang dinas lingkungan, yang dulu ngukur-ngukur laut buat izin itu. Dia nggak mau ngomong di darat. Katanya di darat banyak kuping.
text.en: Pak Darmawan. From the city environment office, the one who did the sea surveys for that permit. He wouldn't talk on land. He said the land has too many ears.

text.id: Namanya nggak usah kamu tahu. Dia nggak mau ngomong di darat. Katanya di darat banyak kuping.
text.en: You don't need his name. He wouldn't talk on land. He said the land has too many ears.

text.id: Saya bawa mereka keluar, lewat patok. Satu jam dia ngomong ke alat rekam anak itu. Saya di buritan, nggak dengerin. Tapi saya denger.
text.en: I took them out, past the stakes. He talked into her recorder for an hour. I was at the stern, not listening. But I heard.

text.id: Pulangnya jam setengah sebelas, di dermaga ada dua orang pake senter. Kaosnya sama kayak yang tadi pagi nanya-nanya ke warung.
text.en: We came back at half past ten, and there were two men on the pier with flashlights. The same shirts as the ones asking at the stall this morning.

text.id: Anak itu langsung matiin HP-nya. Dia bilang, "Pak, HP bisa dicari." Saya nggak ngerti apa-apa soal HP. Saya cuma ngerti dia takut.
text.en: She switched her phone off right away. She said, "Sir, phones can be tracked." I don't know anything about phones. I just knew she was scared.

text.id: "HP bisa dicari." Bapak bilang itu ke saya tiga hari lalu.
text.en: "Phones can be tracked." You said that to me three days ago.

text.id: Itu kata dia. Saya cuma ngulang.
text.en: Those were her words. I was only repeating them.

text.id: Saya tahan kapal di tengah sampai orang-orang itu pergi. Subuh, saya bawa dia ke Pari. Ke rumah sepupu saya. Dia aman. Dia nggak mau pulang sebelum rekamannya aman.
text.en: I kept the boat out until those men left. At dawn, I took her to Pari. To my cousin's house. She's safe. She won't come back until the recording is safe.

text.id: Foto kemarin subuh itu, dia yang minta saya kirim. Dan telepon tanpa suara itu. Dia bilang, "Raka bakal ngerti."
text.en: That photo yesterday at dawn, she asked me to send it. And the call with no voice. She said, "Raka will understand."

text.id: Gue ngerti.
text.en: I understood.
